Comments: The caption should name the head material of the mallet.
Observations of the secretariat: Accepted with modifications. Caption reworded; the head material is named in the caption.

Comments: Use the verb hold rather than grip.
Proposed change: The clamp shall hold the handle with a soft lining.
Observations of the secretariat: Accepted. Wording adopted as proposed; implemented in change/apparatus-wording.

Comments: The test report clause could point to a reporting template.
Proposed change: Add a reference to a reporting template.
Observations of the secretariat: Rejected. No reporting template exists for this fictitious method; the list in the clause is sufficient.

Comments: Seven days of conditioning is too short for dense timber.
Proposed change: for fourteen days before the test
Observations of the secretariat: Accepted with modifications. Conditioning extended, but to ten days, which the drafting group considers sufficient.

Comments: The lower pitch limit is too low; forks below 250 Hz behave differently.
Proposed change: It applies to forks with a nominal pitch between 250 Hz and 900 Hz.
Observations of the secretariat: Accepted. Lower pitch limit raised as proposed.

Comments: The definition should not start with the word change, which reads like an instruction.
Proposed change: variation in the fundamental frequency of a fork over a stated conditioning period
Observations of the secretariat: Accepted with modifications. Definition no longer starts with change; preposition adjusted.

Comments: A clamp height of 80 mm is too low for long forks.
Observations of the secretariat: Accepted. Clamp height increased as proposed.

Comments: Consider deleting this note; it adds nothing.
Observations of the secretariat: Rejected. The note warns about a real cause of drift and is kept.

Comments: A clause on safety is missing; insert a new clause titled Safety before the Apparatus clause.
Proposed change: Wear hearing protection when striking forks repeatedly.
Observations of the secretariat: Accepted. New Safety clause inserted before Apparatus with the proposed text.

Comments: The caption should say what the results are.
Say what the soft lining is made of.
Proposed change: The clamp shall hold the handle with a soft lining. The lining shall be felt.
Observations of the secretariat: Accepted. Lining material stated as proposed.

Comments: These two sentences about the lining should use the same voice.
Proposed change: Replace the lining as soon as it shows wear.
Observations of the secretariat: Accepted with modifications. Voice aligned, keeping when rather than as soon as.

Comments: Consider merging this subclause into its parent clause.
Proposed change: Merge the clamp subclause into the test stand subclause.
Observations of the secretariat: Rejected. The clamp needs its own subclause because it carries two requirements.
